name: Reddit
description: Reddit runs the community discussion site and apps where people post and comment in topic communities. It sells advertising against that attention (about 95 percent of revenue in the June 2026 quarter) and, as a smaller line, licenses its content to other companies. Users and revenue are both growing fast: 130.3 million average daily active uniques in the June 2026 quarter (+18 percent) and revenue $804.9M (+61 percent), at a 91 percent gross margin. 2025 revenue was $2.2B (+69 percent) and net income of $530M. The 10-K flags that Reddit relies on Google search for traffic and that AI tools could substitute for visits.

gics.note: Conventional filing: GICS sector and sub-industry as listed on Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (read 2026-10-01; added to the index 2026-08-18); the list does not show the industry group or industry. SEC SIC code 7374 (Computer Processing & Data Preparation) per EDGAR.

hq.note: San Francisco, CA per EDGAR business address and Wikipedia S&P 500 list

employees.note: 2,555 employees including 1,981 in the US (2,233 a year earlier). FY2025 10-K

businessLines.name: Advertising
businessLines.how: Advertisers pay per click, impression or view (campaigns typically under 30 days); revenue is average daily users times average revenue per user, and rises with more users, more advertisers and better targeting and measurement.
businessLines.description: Ads on the Reddit website and mobile apps, sold by cost per click, cost per thousand impressions, cost per video view or fixed fee.

revenue.note: $1,386.3M vs $823.4M in H1 2025; Q2 2026 $761.6M vs $464.8M. FY2025 split between advertising and other was not extracted from the 10-K.

businessLines.revenueNote: $1,386.3M vs $823.4M in H1 2025; Q2 2026 $761.6M vs $464.8M. FY2025 split between advertising and other was not extracted from the 10-K.

businessLines.name: Other revenue (content licensing and user products)
businessLines.how: Content partners pay for the right to access Reddit's content over a contract period, recognised ratably as they use it; remaining long-term contracted obligations were $92.1M at 2026-06-30. Direct user products are small.
businessLines.description: Licensing access to Reddit content to partners, plus Reddit Premium and Reddit Gold, which were not material.

brands.name: Reddit (website and mobile apps)
brands.share: 130.3M average daily active uniques in Q2 2026 (+18 percent); ARPU $6.18 (+36 percent); about 57 percent of Redditors visited from outside the US in Q4 2025
